name: fmp_crowdfunding_rss
description:
Latest crowdfunding offering filings (SEC Form C) from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/crowdfunding-rss as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): none.
For Reg D / Reg A offerings use fmp_equity_offering; for IPOs fmp_ipo_calendar.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {}
